stories.title: 'Not every season's perfect': After another playoff disappointment, what's next for Fever?
stories.summary: Despite a dominant offense and Caitlin Clark's return, the Fever suffered another early playoff exit.

stories.title: MLB eyes shorter regular season, expanding Division Series to best-of-7
stories.summary: Major League Baseball proposed to shorten the regular season to 154 games from 162 games starting in 2029 and to expand the Division Series to best-of-seven in bargaining with players.

stories.title: Fever's Clark denounces online hate directed at 'good soul' Mitchell
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark said she has talked with Kelsey Mitchell since her teammate spoke about online hate she has received and the difficulty of playing with the Fever.

stories.title: Sources: Payton to expand role in more collaborative playcalling approach
stories.summary: The Broncos are taking a more collaborative playcalling approach this week with coach Sean Payton having an increased role in the process, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

stories.title: Izzo calls his roster-building strategy 'right school' not 'old school'
stories.summary: Longtime Michigan State coach Tom Izzo knows that some think his roster-building strategy is outdated in today's college basketball, but he applies another term to the approach.
